title: ATS Backward Compatibility Fragment
description: Migration provenance and legacy value preservation during schema evolution. Tracks schema version and preserves legacy source strings when migrating from existing metadata shapes.

schema_version.description: Semver of the ATS metadata schema version in use (e.g., '1.0.0'). Required when _compat block is present.

legacy_source.description: Original flat source string value, preserved during migration from existing AskUserQuestion format (e.g., 'remember'). Null if the tool never had a legacy source.

migrated_from.description: Migration provenance tracking the original schema and migration timestamp. Null if this record was never migrated.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool this record was migrated from (e.g., 'AskUserQuestion', 'TaskCreate').

old_schema_version.description: Semver of the schema being migrated from (e.g., '0.9.0' for pre-ATS metadata).

migration_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the migration occurred.

is_legacy_compat.description: True if this record was produced by a caller that hasn't adopted ATS metadata yet. Allows telemetry to distinguish 'no metadata' (old caller) from 'intentionally minimal' (Tier 3). Default: false.
